name: CA-23
label: Likely R

key_factors: District leans Republican by about nine points
Obernolte holds a massive fundraising edge ($1.4M vs $17K cash on hand)
No polls or expert ratings show the race competitive; markets price Obernolte near 98%
Democratic-friendly national environment is the main offsetting factor
model.rationale: The district's nine-point Republican lean, Obernolte's overwhelming financial advantage, and the absence of any polling, ratings, or outside spending suggesting competition keep this firmly Republican despite a Democratic-leaning national environment.
model.watch: A wave of Democratic outside spending or credible polling showing a single-digit race would move the outlook toward Tossup.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
California's 23rd District leans Republican by about nine points, and Rep. Jay Obernolte is seeking re-election with the advantages of incumbency. He has raised roughly $1.8 million and holds about $1.4 million on hand, while Democratic challenger Tessa Lynn Hodge has raised about $123,000 with under $20,000 available. Outside groups have barely engaged, with modest sums supporting Obernolte and almost nothing on the other side.

No public general-election polls or expert ratings cover the race, so the outlook rests on district fundamentals and the money gap. Prediction markets price Obernolte's chances near 98 percent. A strongly Democratic national environment could narrow the margin, but the combination of a favorable seat, a well-funded incumbent, and an under-resourced challenger leaves Hodge facing a steep climb. Obernolte is favored by roughly nine points.
